name: lazy-lions-mcp

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Search or filter Lions/Cubs by traits, sale status, and unlock status. Use this for questions like 'which Lions have a Crown', 'show me Cubs for sale under 0.1 ETH', or 'how many Lions have blue eyes'. Returns paginated tokens with their traits and listing state.

collection.description: Which collection to query. 'lions' = Lazy Lions, 'cubs' = Lazy Cubs.

traits.description: Trait filter as JSON, e.g. {"Headgear":"Crown","Eyes":"Laser"}. Trait names are case-sensitive.

for_sale.description: Only tokens currently listed for sale.

tools.name: smart_search
tools.description: Natural-language search over the collection. Give it a plain-English request like 'lions with a crown and laser eyes that are for sale' and it resolves the traits and filters for you. Prefer this when the user's phrasing is fuzzy; use search_tokens when you already know exact trait names.

query.description: Natural-language description of the tokens to find.

collection.description: Which collection to query. 'lions' = Lazy Lions, 'cubs' = Lazy Cubs.

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: Full detail for one Lion or Cub by token number: traits, rarity rank, current owner, listing status, and unlock state (butt / front face for Lions).

collection.description: Which collection to query. 'lions' = Lazy Lions, 'cubs' = Lazy Cubs.

tools.name: get_traits
tools.description: The full trait catalog for a collection: every trait type, its possible values, and how many tokens carry each. Use this to learn valid trait names before calling search_tokens, or to answer rarity questions.

collection.description: Which collection to query. 'lions' = Lazy Lions, 'cubs' = Lazy Cubs.

tools.name: get_rarity
tools.description: Rarity scores and ranks for a token, blending trait rarity with market signals (last sale, current ask).

collection.description: Which collection to query. 'lions' = Lazy Lions, 'cubs' = Lazy Cubs.

tools.name: get_floors
tools.description: Current floor price for a collection, plus the cheapest listed token.

collection.description: Which collection to query. 'lions' = Lazy Lions, 'cubs' = Lazy Cubs.

tools.name: get_listings
tools.description: Tokens currently listed for sale, with prices and marketplace links.

collection.description: Which collection to query. 'lions' = Lazy Lions, 'cubs' = Lazy Cubs.

tools.name: get_collection_stats
tools.description: Headline stats for the ecosystem: supply, unique holders, listed counts, and unlock totals.

collection.description: Which collection to query. 'lions' = Lazy Lions, 'cubs' = Lazy Cubs.

tools.name: get_holder
tools.description: Everything a wallet owns across the ecosystem — Lions, Cubs, and Generals — aggregated across all of that holder's linked wallets. Accepts an address or a Lazy Lions username.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...) or Lazy Lions username.

include_linked.description: Aggregate across the holder's linked wallets.

tools.name: get_holder_profile
tools.description: Public profile for a holder: username, bio, avatar, holdings summary, and earned Pride Mark badges.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...) or Lazy Lions username.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Top holders ranked by total NFTs, Lions, Cubs, or badges earned.

tools.name: get_lazy_market
tools.description: Live $LAZY market data on Base: price, 24h change, volume, and liquidity.

tools.name: get_lazy_protocol
tools.description: Ecosystem-wide $LAZY snapshot: total supply, burned (verified against the on-chain dead-address balance), circulating, locked, pending unlock, and the count of active lockers.

tools.name: get_lazy_balance
tools.description: A wallet's $LAZY position: liquid balance plus any amount locked on-chain, optionally aggregated across the holder's linked wallets.

tools.name: get_lazy_leaderboard
tools.description: $LAZY leaderboards: wallets ranked by total tokens burned, or by amount currently locked on-chain.

address.description: Optional: return just this wallet's rank and totals.

tools.name: get_lazy_burns
tools.description: Individual $LAZY burn events, newest first, each with transaction hash and Basescan link. Cub rerolls burn $LAZY, so this doubles as a live feed of reroll activity.

since.description: ISO timestamp — only events at or after it. Use for incremental polling.

tools.name: get_token_history
tools.description: History for one token: ownership transfers, and for Cubs the full reroll history showing how its art and traits changed over time.

collection.description: Which collection to query. 'lions' = Lazy Lions, 'cubs' = Lazy Cubs.

kind.description: 'transfers' for ownership history, 'rerolls' for Cub reroll history.

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Recent ecosystem activity feed: ownership changes, listings, rerolls, and unlocks since a timestamp. Use this to monitor the collection rather than repeatedly re-reading full lists.

since.description: ISO timestamp to read changes from.

instructions: Read-only access to the Lazy Lions NFT ecosystem: 10,000 Lions and the Lazy Cubs on Ethereum, Glitch's Army ordinals on Bitcoin, and the $LAZY token on Base. Use search_tokens for trait queries, get_token for one Lion or Cub, get_holder for what a wallet owns, and the lazy_* tools for token economics. Holding a Lazy Lion also grants access to LazyEdge (1 Lion for the terminal, 5 for the API) — see https://lazylionsnft.com/agents/why-hold.
